normative_precedence.joint_authority: Every v1d file in normative_file_inventory is jointly normative. No listed file silently overrides another.
normative_precedence.historical_only: v1a, v1b, and v1c proposal files are provenance and defect evidence only; v1c consensus is binding repair provenance but no v1c runtime byte has inherited authority.
normative_precedence.contradiction: Any missing inventory entry, unregistered producer or consumer, unregistered object shape or ordering, unmapped condition, multiple mapping, or disagreement among listed v1d bytes is INVALID_PRECONDITION/PROTOCOL_CONTRADICTION before dispatch. Implementation and tests may reject but may not choose a preferred reading.
normative_precedence.completeness_test: P1CB01 extracts the v1d paths named by change.json and requires exact set equality with normative_file_inventory; it then verifies every producer_consumer_matrix, object_schema_registry, ordering_registry, validity_registry, ledger_registry, review_boundary, and claim_boundary assertion.

ordering_registry.order: project both lives and E-to-M plans, shared probe, host-only goal and question, vocabularies, public DIST, frozen vectors; then first heldout dispatch
proposal premise_ids in emitted order followed by support_row_ids in supplied additional_rows order, first-occurrence deduplicated
46 WAKE plus 22 interleaved REACTIVATE plus 16 SLEEP slots form one 84-slot common prefix
after the common 84-slot prefix and THINK0, M0 has zero return attempts while OWN and DIST independently execute slots 84 through 99 in ascending order
slots 0 through 11 ascend until trace terminal or failure; valid nonterminal slot 11 seals BUDGET_EXHAUSTED and no slot 12 exists
after goal reveal but before any T output, sort path exclusions by semantic_hash and minimize the registered sham objective with lexicographic final tie break
seal all six plans, run every runnable T-M0, T-OWN, T-DIST, T-TWIN, T-PATH, and T-SHAM trace without outcome cancellation, then score
seal all eighteen NO_MEMORY, GOLD_TEXT, and GOLD_TWIN traces before any DEV scoring
rows by semantic_hash, view family by compiler_views ordinal, missing_index ascending, candidate array in prospectively sealed order
two pristine independent fits and both complete 48-case fidelity sets seal absent infrastructure invalidity; evaluate the joint gate; only then dispatch any L thinker opportunity
precondition, authority, one of exactly three stage gates, prior infrastructure invalidity, trace-local prior terminal, duplicate, dispatch
immutable packet, reviewer and advocate assignments, separate unchanged-byte dispositions, authority token or HUMAN_TERMINAL

validity_registry.condition: protocol contradiction, bad lock or scope, missing or invalid review artifact, authority ordering error, actor overlap, rejection, changed reviewed byte, public DIST mismatch, or fixture infeasibility
refusal, timeout, truncation, output limit, runtime or revision drift, state reuse, partial fit, or LoRA runtime failure after dispatch or fit start
validity_registry.dispatch_effect: failed work counts once; no retry

validity_registry.condition: model output failure, illegal operation, wrong commit, missing citation, budget exhaustion, missing abstraction, sham infeasibility, behavioral gate failure, or fidelity failure
validity_registry.dispatch_effect: execute the prospectively runnable set, then stop under the exact failure route
advance only after both approving dispositions and one bound token

validity_registry.authority_reason_domain: DEFERRED is forbidden in authority tokens
validity_registry.dispatch_effect: terminate only that trace; other prospectively registered branches and arms continue
execute the other five T arms, zero-attempt T-SHAM, and forbid full or weakened causal-use credit

ledger_registry.state_reason_rule: The x-semantic-contract condition_state_reason_map in opportunity_ledger.schema.json is exhaustive and byte-authoritative. Consumers reference condition identifiers and may not restate a competing vocabulary.
ledger_registry.stage_failure_rule: NON_DISPATCH_STAGE_FAILURE is legal only for NON_DISPATCH_STAGE_MISSING_ABSTRACTION, NON_DISPATCH_STAGE_SHAM_INFEASIBLE, and NON_DISPATCH_STAGE_FIDELITY_FAILURE.
ledger_registry.post_terminal_rule: NON_DISPATCH_POST_TERMINAL is legal only for later opportunities in the same trace after COMMIT, REQUEST_RETURN, DEFER, budget exhaustion, or terminal thinker model-output failure. It is never a stage-gate or cross-stage encoding.
ledger_registry.post_invalid_rule: Later opportunities blocked by a dispatched infrastructure invalidity use NON_DISPATCH_POST_INVALID/PRIOR_INFRASTRUCTURE_INVALIDITY, never NON_DISPATCH_POST_TERMINAL.
ledger_registry.P1CB09_rule: Verify one row per registered opportunity, unique opportunity_id, the exact condition/state/reason triple, cause scope, attempt and token fields, all ceilings, no retry, and rejection of unlisted, multiply applicable, or cross-contract-different mappings.

return_intervention_boundary.common_prefix: M0, OWN, and DIST retain the complete identical recurrent prefix of 46 WAKE, 22 REACTIVATE, and 16 SLEEP slots.
return_intervention_boundary.intervention: P1CB06 changes only the post-prefix return treatment: literal zero return for M0 versus sixteen goal-routed OWN or public-control DIST return slots.
return_intervention_boundary.permitted_inference: P1CB06 is schedule executability and branch-matching evidence for the return loop after a common prefix.
forbidden_inferences: repeated dreaming as a whole was necessary
graph growth as a whole was necessary

review_boundary.separation: Reviewer and advocate roles, actor identifiers, fresh-context receipts, and packet equality are platform-attested and schema-checked workflow facts only.
review_boundary.not_proved: The package does not claim cryptographic, ontological, human, or model independence from identity receipts or actor_id inequality.
review_boundary.reviewer_supremacy: An advocate may explain or recommend repair but cannot override REJECT or INVALID; changed bytes require new ratification and new reviews.
review_boundary.packet_requirements: Every packet contains P1CB10, the broad-positive and broad-negative claim-rejection fixture receipt, the platform separation attestation, and the canonical ledger/schema consistency artifacts applicable to that transition.

required_terminal_facts: public actions were generated by the frozen environment rather than chosen or improved by the model
review separation was platform-attested rather than proved
the experiment is one aligned seed-5 pair under a game-specific ontology and proof-sequence scaffold
SUPPORTED denotes model-claimed support rather than verified truth
LoRA access, when applicable, is immediate host-rostered candidate-constrained recognition
positive_rejection_fixtures: recurrence as a whole was necessary
action selection or action improvement was demonstrated
online learning or continued improvement was demonstrated
whole-corpus storage or preservation was demonstrated
superiority over a baseline was demonstrated
text and LoRA memory were equivalent
negative_rejection_fixtures: recurrence is ineffective or unnecessary in general
constructive memory is impossible in general
the model cannot form or use abstractions in general
the model, prompt, schedule, reducer, reader, runtime, or optimizer was uniquely at fault
LoRA cannot preserve or expose memories in general
a sham failure shows the mechanism failed rather than the registered control was unidentifiable
a fidelity failure establishes no adapter can work
a one-pair failure establishes a Paper-1-wide negative conclusion
claim_boundary.sham_failure_claim: SHAM_NOT_IDENTIFIABLE permits descriptive reporting of the five executed arms and the control-identifiability failure only. It supports neither the full causal-use claim nor a weakened replacement causal claim.
claim_boundary.claim_fixture_test: P1CB10 must reject every listed positive and negative fixture, accept only wording within the registered maximum, require every terminal fact, and preserve unconditional HUMAN_TERMINAL.
